title: Wardrobe and Undertow
author: Cyrus Okonkwo
blurb: Zephyrine Fairweather, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has spent ten years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
